description: Two comparators, each putting out a 10V gate while one of its two inputs is above the other

inputs.text: The voltage tested against a2; the a output goes high while this one is the greater
The voltage a1 is tested against; the a output goes high while a1 is above this one
The voltage tested against b2; the b output goes high while this one is the greater
The voltage b1 is tested against; the b output goes high while b1 is above this one

outputs.text: Carries 10V while a1 is above a2 and 0V otherwise, and stays at 0V unless both a1 and a2 are patched
Carries 10V while b1 is above b2 and 0V otherwise, and stays at 0V unless both b1 and b2 are patched

notes: a channel does nothing until both of its inputs are patched: with one cable alone the output holds 0V and the lamp stays dark
nothing on the panel is lettered; the artwork carries the module name and no control labels at all
